desc: Buffer overflow in legacy industrial control systems (ICS)
remediation: Isolate ICS from the main network and apply vendor patch.

desc: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in primary HR portal login page
remediation: Sanitize all user inputs on the login form.

desc: Unauthenticated REST API endpoint exposing user PII
remediation: Enforce OAuth2 or JWT authentication on all API endpoints.

desc: Docker container escape vulnerability in runtime
remediation: Update Docker engine to the latest stable release and avoid running containers as root.

desc: Cleartext storage of sensitive tokens in local storage
remediation: Move sensitive tokens to HttpOnly, Secure cookies.
